headline.title: Read this before you vibe-code another app
headline.summary: Bob Starr's website "Boomberg," which tracks US tax money allocated to tech companies, was launched quickly using vibe-coding techniques. Months later, he discovered a hidden SQL injection vulnerability that could have compromised the site's security.

articles.title: Hotter Than a Hot Tub: The 45°C Breakthrough to Cool AI’s Biggest Machines
articles.summary: NVIDIA has developed new AI servers capable of operating with cooling liquid temperatures up to 45°C, significantly higher than typical hot tub temperatures. This breakthrough enhances energy efficiency in AI machine cooling systems.

articles.title: Some Electricians Think Building Data Centers Is for Sellouts
articles.summary: As Big Tech invests heavily in data center construction, some electricians are expressing concerns about the ethical implications of working on these projects amid rising national opposition. This growing skepticism highlights a divide within the workforce regarding the value and impact of building data centers.

articles.title: World Cup Scams Are Getting Harder to Spot
articles.summary: AI technology is increasingly being used to create sophisticated scams related to the World Cup, including counterfeit tickets and cloned websites. As a result, fans are finding it more challenging to differentiate between legitimate offers and fraudulent schemes.

articles.title: Samsung Electronics brings ChatGPT and Codex to employees
articles.summary: Samsung Electronics has implemented ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex for its global workforce, representing one of the largest deployments of OpenAI's AI technologies in an enterprise setting. This initiative aims to enhance productivity and streamline operations across the company.

articles.title: Beyond Siri: Here are the practical AI features coming to your iPhone in iOS 27
articles.summary: iOS 27 will introduce several practical AI features beyond the revamped Siri, enhancing user experience on iPhones. These updates, showcased at WWDC, aim to improve functionality and usability across various applications within the operating system.

articles.title: When the Trump administration cracks down on Anthropic, who benefits?
articles.summary: The latest episode of Equity examines the Trump administration's actions against Anthropic, exploring the motivations behind these moves and their potential implications for the AI ecosystem. The discussion highlights the stakeholders who may benefit from the administration's crackdown.

articles.title: 28 Tips to Take Your ChatGPT Prompts to the Next Level
articles.summary: The article provides 28 practical tips for enhancing the effectiveness of prompts used with OpenAI's ChatGPT, enabling users to achieve more engaging and relevant responses. By applying these strategies, users can optimize their interactions with the chatbot for improved outcomes.
